name: remote-permission-cycle-presses-shift-tab-and-keeps-the-mode
description: In remote mode Cycle Permission Mode presses Shift+Tab in the remote session and leaves the configured permission mode as it was.
reason: Interactive Claude Code cycles its modes with Shift+Tab, and which mode it lands on depends on where it already was. Nothing reports that back, so PowerUp must not claim a mode it cannot see.
source: AppState.cyclePermissionMode (remote branch comment); MainView permission chip shows a dash in remote mode
